name: MiniMax Agent
desc: MiniMax's platform for building general-purpose agents
desc_zh: MiniMax 的通用智能体搭建平台
solves: An agent that runs unattended still needs models chosen, orchestration written and failures handled. The platform arrives with those set.
solves_zh: 一个能自己跑起来的智能体，模型要选、编排要写、异常要兜。这三样平台已经配好。
best_for: Shipping a general-purpose agent without hand-building the runtime underneath it yourself first.
best_for_zh: 要上线一个通用智能体，但不想自己搭底层运行时。
notes: 官网 agent.minimaxi.com 返回 302 跳转 agent.minimax.cn（境内域名，homepage 字段未改），跳转后确认标题「MiniMax Agent」。
